archetypes.description: A midfielder whose measurable work is defensive: tackles, interceptions and duels, with enough passing to keep the ball after winning it.
archetypes.label: Ball-winning pivot

archetypes.description: A midfielder who receives and moves the ball in volume with accuracy and creates from deep. Forward-pass splits are not in the feed; completed passes and key passes are the available evidence.
archetypes.label: Deep-lying playmaker

archetypes.description: A defender whose passing and retention are closer to a midfielder's: volume, accuracy, progression through key passes and the ability to carry the ball out of a challenge.
archetypes.label: Build-up defender

archetypes.description: A wide or attacking midfielder who beats players and creates: successful dribbles, dribble success rate, key passes and goal contributions.
archetypes.label: Wide dribbler

archetypes.description: An attacker whose measurable contribution leans to creating rather than finishing: pass volume and accuracy, key passes, assists and successful dribbles. The feed carries no cross or chance-creation data, so key passes are the closest available creation signal.
archetypes.label: Assist-biased contributor

archetypes.description: An attacker whose measurable contribution leans to scoring: goals, shot volume, conversion and total goal contribution. Pass and dribble volume are deliberately excluded so this profile does not duplicate the assist-biased one.
archetypes.label: Goal-scoring forward

archetypes.description: A goalkeeper whose save rate is high and whose goals conceded per 90 is low. The feed does not carry post-shot xG, so this is a shot-stopping profile, not an expected-goals verdict.
archetypes.label: Goalkeeper shot-stopper

attackers.note: Assist bias and goal bias are separate profile scores. The goal-scoring list is ordered by goals per 90 at the pool minutes threshold, not by the composite profile.

known_gaps: 7 enabled leagues return no player season statistics (Scottish Championship/League One/League Two and four other leagues); their pages say so instead of zero-filling.
Contracts, wages, fees, release clauses and agent fees are not in the fed data.
No event coordinates, xG/xA, progressive passes, carries, pressures, aerial wins or crosses.
Role families need starting-XI grids; leagues without them use the provider group.
Provider ratings are opaque and league-relative; no cross-league ranking is published.
The availability ledger has only the verified official AFC entries; every other injury state is unknown.
This is a profile search, not a target list or a recommendation.

limitations: Provider ratings are relative to a league and role cohort; they are not a verdict.
The model cannot separate selection, availability and quality.
Assist bias and goal bias are profile descriptions, not causal claims.
No contracts, wages, fees or release clauses are claimed.
No target list and no Aberdeen FC recommendation.

team_lens.definition: Team points-per-game percentile at or below the threshold; player lift is the role-adjusted percentile minus the team points percentile.
team_lens.label: Outperforming struggling teams

limitations: The GBP band is fitted only from a public-source anchor register; it is not a fee or a market quote.
Contract length, wages, release clauses and agent fees are unknown.
The performance input is the league-adjusted scouting percentile; the league adjustment is an empirical model.
